en: Remove backgrounds instantly. All features free.
tr: Elimina fons a l’instant. Totes les funcions gratis.
back: Remove funds instantly. All features are free.

en: Open a photo and our on-device AI removes the background automatically — no internet required. You can also swap in your own custom background.
tr: Obre una foto i la IA del dispositiu elimina el fons automàticament — sense internet. També pots canviar-lo per un fons personalitzat teu.
back: Open a photo and the AI of the device automatically removes the background  without the internet. You can also change it to a custom background of your own.

en: Paint away what the AI missed or restore what you want to keep. Then crop, rotate, move and resize.
tr: Esborra amb el pinzell el que la IA ha passat per alt o restaura el que vols conservar. Després retalla, gira, mou i canvia la mida.
back: Brush away what the AI has overlooked or restore what you want to preserve, then cut, spin, move, and resize.

en: Choose a colour, gradient, template or your own photo, with a natural shadow. Marketplace presets for Amazon, eBay, Etsy and Shopify set size and format for you.
tr: Tria un color, un degradat, una plantilla o la teva pròpia foto, amb una ombra natural. Els ajustos per a Amazon, eBay, Etsy i Shopify fixen la mida i el format per tu.
back: Choose a color, a gradient, a template, or your own photo, with a natural shadow.

en: Batch it, export it, keep it private
tr: Per lots, al format que vulguis, en privat
back: In lots, in any format you want, privately.

en: Cut out up to 30 photos at once and export as PNG, JPG or WEBP. Your photos never leave your phone. Available in 43 languages.
tr: Retalla fins a 30 fotos alhora i exporta en PNG, JPG o WEBP. Les teves fotos no surten mai del telèfon. Disponible en 43 idiomes.
back: It cuts up to 30 photos at a time and exports them in PNG, JPG or WEBP. Your photos never come out of your phone. Available in 43 languages.

tr: Elimina el fons de les fotos a l'instant amb PhotoSur — gratis i sense marca d'aigua.

tr: Torna-ho a provar o reinicia l'aplicació si el problema continua.
back: Try it again or restart the app if the problem persists.

tr: Aquest dispositiu no té cap càmera disponible.

en: Cleaner edges on tricky objects like shoes, bags and bottles. It downloads once, stays on your phone and then works offline. Mobile data charges may apply.
tr: Vores més netes en objectes difícils com sabates, bosses i ampolles. Es baixa una sola vegada, es queda al telèfon i després funciona sense connexió. Pot haver-hi costos de dades mòbils.
back: It's cleaner in hard objects like shoes, bags, and bottles. It comes down once, stays on the phone, and then runs offline. There can be mobile data costs.

en: Exported images are removed from this phone. Your original photos and anything saved to your gallery are not affected.
tr: Les imatges exportades se suprimeixen d’aquest telèfon. Les fotos originals i el que has desat a la galeria no es veuen afectats.
back: The exported images are deleted from this phone.

tr: No s’ha pogut desar a la galeria.
back: He couldn't make it to the gallery.
You want to eliminate all exports?
Help and How to Use It

en: Tap a topic to read how it works.
tr: Toca un tema per llegir com funciona.
back: Play a theme to read how it works.

en: On the home screen, tap Camera to take a photo or Gallery to pick one. Batch cuts out many photos at once.
tr: A la pantalla d’inici, toca Càmera per fer una foto o Galeria per triar-ne una. Lot retalla moltes fotos alhora.
back: On the start screen, tap Camera to take a photo or Gallery to choose one. Lot cuts many photos at once.

en: Every photo opens in Crop & Rotate first, then in the editor. Your original photo is never changed.
tr: Cada foto s’obre primer a Retalla i gira i després a l’editor. La foto original no es modifica mai.
back: Each photo opens first in Retalla and turns and then to the editor.

en: When you are happy, tap Export in the editor. Recent Exports on the home screen lists everything you have exported.
tr: Quan estiguis satisfet, toca Exporta a l’editor. Exportacions recents, a la pantalla d’inici, mostra tot el que has exportat.
back: When you're satisfied, tap Export to the publisher. Recent exports, on the home screen, shows everything you've exported.

en: Turn the photo left or right in 90° steps, and drag the frame to choose the part you want to keep.
tr: Gira la foto cap a l’esquerra o cap a la dreta de 90° en 90° i arrossega el marc per triar la part que vols conservar.
back: Turn the photo to the left or to the right of 90° by 90° and drag the frame to choose the part you want to keep.

en: Free lets you shape the frame as you like. 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 lock its shape. Tap Continue to open the editor.
tr: Lliure et deixa donar al marc la forma que vulguis. 1:1, 4:5 i 9:16 en fixen la forma. Toca Continua per obrir l’editor.
back: Free allows you to give the frame the shape you want. 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 fix the shape.

en: When the editor opens, PhotoSur finds the main subject and removes the background automatically, on your phone. No internet is needed.
tr: Quan s’obre l’editor, PhotoSur troba el subjecte principal i n’elimina el fons automàticament, al telèfon. No cal connexió a Internet.
back: When you open the editor, PhotoSur finds the main subject and automatically deletes the background on the phone.

en: Edge Smoothness softens the edge of the cut-out, from 0 to 20 pixels.
tr: Suavitat de vores suavitza la vora del retall, de 0 a 20 píxels.
back: Edge smoothness smooths the edge of the cut, from 0 to 20 pixels.

en: The eye button at the top shows your original photo so you can compare. Tap it again to go back. The brush is paused while the original is shown.
tr: El botó en forma d’ull, a la part superior, mostra la foto original per comparar. Torna’l a tocar per tornar enrere. El pinzell queda en pausa mentre es veu l’original.
back: The eye-shaped button, at the top, shows the original photo to compare. Touch it again to go back. The brush stops while the original is viewed.

en: For difficult subjects such as glass, shoes, bags and bottles, tap Get HD cut-out. The HD model downloads once, stays on your phone and then works offline. Once it is installed, every new cut-out uses it automatically. To redo the photo you have open, tap Redo cut-out in HD.
tr: Per a subjectes difícils, com el vidre, les sabates, les bosses i les ampolles, toca Obtén el retall HD. El model HD es baixa una sola vegada, es queda al telèfon i després funciona sense connexió. Un cop instal·lat, cada retall nou l’utilitza automàticament. Per refer la foto oberta, toca Torna a fer el retall en HD.
back: For difficult subjects, such as glass, shoes, bags and bottles, tap Get the HD cut. The HD model is downloaded once, stays on the phone, and then works without connection. Once installed, each new cut is automatically used.

en: Erase removes parts of the subject. Restore brings back parts the cut-out removed.
tr: Esborra treu parts del subjecte. Restaura recupera parts que el retall havia tret.
back: Delete removes parts of the subject. Restore recovers parts that the cut had removed.

en: Drag one finger to paint. Use two fingers to zoom, up to 8 times, and to move the photo. The brush keeps its size on screen, so zooming in gives finer control.
tr: Arrossega un dit per pintar. Fes servir dos dits per ampliar, fins a 8 vegades, i per moure la foto. El pinzell manté la mida a la pantalla, de manera que, si amplies, treballes amb més precisió.
back: Pull one finger to paint. Use two fingers to expand, up to eight times, and move the photo. The brush keeps the size on the screen, so if you expand, you work more accurately.

en: Brush Size goes from 1 to 50. Opacity sets how strongly each stroke applies.
tr: Mida del pinzell va d’1 a 50. Opacitat defineix la intensitat de cada traç.
back: Brush size ranges from 1 to 50. Opacity defines the intensity of each stroke.

en: Undo and Redo step through your brush strokes. Reset clears all brush strokes and goes back to the automatic cut-out; it asks you to confirm first.
tr: Desfés i Refés recorren els teus traços de pinzell. Restableix esborra tots els traços i torna al retall automàtic; abans et demana confirmació.
back: Deface and Reface go through your brush strokes. Restore erase all strokes and go back to automatic cutting; first it asks for confirmation.

en: Choose what goes behind your subject: transparent, white, black, a gradient, a colour, a blurred copy of your photo, or your own photo.
tr: Tria què hi ha darrere del subjecte: transparent, blanc, negre, un degradat, un color, una còpia desenfocada de la foto o la teva pròpia foto.
back: Pick out what's behind the subject: transparent, white, black, a degraded, a color, a blurred copy of the photo or your own photo.

en: Only one background is used at a time. Your latest choice replaces the earlier one.
tr: Només s’utilitza un fons alhora. L’última tria substitueix l’anterior.
back: Only one fund is used at a time.

en: Add custom background lets you pick a photo from your gallery. Custom color opens a colour picker. The Blur slider goes from 0 to 25.
tr: Afegeix un fons personalitzat et permet triar una foto de la galeria. Color personalitzat obre un selector de color. El control Desenfocament va de 0 a 25.
back: Adding a custom background allows you to select a photo from the gallery. Custom color opens a color selector.

en: Transparent shows a checkerboard while you edit. Export as PNG to keep it transparent.
tr: Transparent mostra un patró de quadres mentre edites. Exporta en PNG per conservar la transparència.
back: Transparent displays a pattern of images as you edit. It exports to PNG to maintain transparency.

en: Templates are ready-made backgrounds in five groups: Studio, Color block, Textures, Light & shadow, and Gradients & patterns. Five scenes are shown in the panel; tap the Templates button to see them all.
tr: Les plantilles són fons ja fets en cinc grups: Estudi, Blocs de color, Textures, Llum i ombra i Degradats i patrons. Al tauler apareixen cinc escenes; toca el botó Plantilles per veure-les totes.
back: The templates are backgrounds already made into five groups: Studio, Color Blocks, Textures, Light and Shadow and Degradates and Patterns. Five scenes appear on the board; tap the Templates button to view them all.

en: Choosing a template works like choosing your own photo as the background: it replaces your earlier background choice.
tr: Triar una plantilla és com triar una foto teva com a fons: substitueix la tria de fons anterior.
back: Choosing a template is like choosing a photo of yourself as a background: it replaces the previous background selection.

en: Drag the subject on the photo to move it. Pinch with two fingers to resize it.
tr: Arrossega el subjecte per la foto per moure’l. Pessiga amb dos dits per canviar-ne la mida.
back: Pull the subject through the photo to move it. Push with two fingers to change the size.

en: Choose Original, 1:1, 4:5 or 9:16 to set the shape of the final picture.
tr: Tria Original, 1:1, 4:5 o 9:16 per definir la forma de la imatge final.
back: Choose Original, 1:1, 4:5 or 9:16 to define the shape of the final image.

en: Size sets how big the subject is, from 20% to 300%. Shadow sets how strong its shadow is. Auto-center puts the subject back in the middle. Reset undoes moving and resizing.
tr: Mida defineix la grandària del subjecte, del 20% al 300%. Ombra defineix la intensitat de l’ombra. Centra torna el subjecte al mig. Restableix desfà els moviments i els canvis de mida.
back: Shadow defines the intensity of the shadow. Center returns the subject to the middle. Restores movements and changes of size.

en: This shape is used when the export size is Original. If you choose a size preset or a marketplace in the export sheet, that decides the final shape instead.
tr: Aquesta forma s’aplica quan la mida d’exportació és Original. Si al full d’exportació tries una mida predefinida o un marketplace, aquesta decideix la forma final.
back: This form applies when the export size is Original. If on the export sheet you choose a predefined size or a marketplace, it decides the final form.

en: Tap Export to open the export sheet. Nothing is applied until you tap Save to Gallery or Share, so you can change your choices as often as you like.
tr: Toca Exporta per obrir el full d’exportació. No s’aplica res fins que toquis Desa a la Galeria o Comparteix, de manera que pots canviar les opcions tantes vegades com vulguis.
back: Touch Export to open the export sheet. Nothing applies until you touch Delete to the Gallery or Share, so you can change the options as many times as you like.

en: PNG keeps transparency. JPG makes smaller files but cannot be transparent, so a transparent background becomes white. WEBP is a small modern format; if your phone cannot make it, the file is saved as JPG. For JPG and WEBP, the Quality slider trades file size for detail.
tr: PNG conserva la transparència. JPG genera fitxers més petits però no pot ser transparent, de manera que un fons transparent es torna blanc. WEBP és un format modern i compacte; si el telèfon no el pot crear, el fitxer es desa com a JPG. Per a JPG i WEBP, el control Qualitat equilibra la mida del fitxer i el detall.
back: PNG maintains transparency. JPG generates smaller files but cannot be transparent, so a transparent background becomes white. WEBP is a modern and compact format; if the phone cannot create it, the file is referred to as JPG. For JPG and WEBP, Quality control balances file size and detail.

en: Original keeps your photo’s size, with the shape chosen in Layout. 1:1 is 1080 × 1080, 4:5 is 1080 × 1350 and 9:16 is 1080 × 1920. Custom lets you type a width and height in pixels.
tr: Original conserva la mida de la foto, amb la forma triada a Disseny. 1:1 és 1080 × 1080, 4:5 és 1080 × 1350 i 9:16 és 1080 × 1920. Personalitzat et permet introduir l’amplada i l’alçada en píxels.
back: Original retains the size of the photo, with the shape chosen in Design. 1:1 is 1080 × 1080, 4:5 is 1080 × 1350 and 9:16 is 1080 × 1920.

en: Marketplace presets set size, format and quality: Amazon 2000 × 2000 JPG, eBay 1600 × 1600 JPG, Etsy 2667 × 2000 JPG kept under 1 MB, and Shopify 2048 × 2048 PNG. Choosing one replaces your format and size choices, and choosing a format or size afterwards switches the marketplace off. Marketplace rules can change, so check your marketplace’s current requirements.
tr: Els valors predefinits de marketplace fixen mida, format i qualitat: Amazon 2000 × 2000 JPG, eBay 1600 × 1600 JPG, Etsy 2667 × 2000 JPG per sota d’1 MB i Shopify 2048 × 2048 PNG. En triar-ne un se substitueixen les opcions de format i mida; si després tries un format o una mida, el marketplace es desmarca. Les normes dels marketplaces poden canviar, així que comprova els requisits actuals del teu.
back: The default marketplace values set size, format, and quality: Amazon 2000 × 2000 JPG, eBay 1600 × 1600 JPG, Etsy 2667 × 2000 JPG under d1 MB, and Shopify 2048 × 2048 PNG. By choosing one, the format and size options are replaced; if you then choose a format or a size, the marketplace is unmarked.

en: Amazon also uses a pure white background with no shadow and fits the subject to fill most of the frame. Your background choice in the editor is not changed. The other marketplaces keep your background.
tr: Amazon també utilitza un fons blanc pur sense ombra i ajusta el subjecte perquè ocupi la major part del marc. La tria de fons de l’editor no canvia. Els altres marketplaces conserven el teu fons.
back: Amazon also uses a pure shadowless white background and adjusts the subject to occupy most of the frame. The editor's background selection does not change. Other marketplaces keep your background.

en: Save to Gallery and Share both save the picture to your gallery and to Recent Exports. Share also opens your phone’s share menu. If saving to the gallery is not possible, the share menu opens instead. After exporting you return to the home screen.
tr: Desa a la Galeria i Comparteix desen tots dos la imatge a la galeria i a Exportacions recents. Comparteix, a més, obre el menú de compartir del telèfon. Si no es pot desar a la galeria, s’obre el menú de compartir. Després d’exportar, tornes a la pantalla d’inici.
back: Delete to the gallery and Share both draw the image to the gallery and to Recent Exports. Delete, in addition, open the sharing menu on the phone. If you can't go to the gallery, open the sharing menu. After exporting, go back to the start screen.

en: Unless you have removed ads, an ad can appear after an export, at most once every two minutes.
tr: Si no has eliminat els anuncis, pot aparèixer un anunci després d’una exportació, com a màxim un cop cada dos minuts.
back: If you have not deleted the advertisements, an advertisement may appear after an export, no more than once every two minutes.

en: Batch cuts out up to 30 photos in one go. Tap Batch on the home screen and pick your photos. The back button is turned off while a batch runs.
tr: Lot retalla fins a 30 fotos alhora. Toca Lot a la pantalla d’inici i tria les fotos. El botó Enrere està desactivat mentre s’executa un lot.
back: Lot cuts up to 30 photos at a time. Tap Lot on the Start screen and select the photos. The Back button is disabled while a lot is running.

en: All photos in a batch share one setup: one background and one marketplace. You cannot choose differently for each photo.
tr: Totes les fotos d’un lot comparteixen una sola configuració: un fons i un marketplace. No pots triar de manera diferent per a cada foto.
back: All photos in a batch share a single configuration: a background and a marketplace. You can't choose differently for each photo.

en: Backgrounds work as in the editor: your own photo, a colour, a template, white, transparent, black, blur or a gradient. Only one applies, and your latest choice replaces the earlier one.
tr: Els fons funcionen com a l’editor: una foto teva, un color, una plantilla, blanc, transparent, negre, desenfocat o un degradat. Només se n’aplica un, i l’última tria substitueix l’anterior.
back: The background works like an editor: a photo of you, a color, a template, white, transparent, black, blurred or a degraded one. Only one is applied, and the last choice replaces the previous one.

en: The file format is chosen for you. With a marketplace, the photos follow that marketplace’s size and format. Without one, a transparent background gives PNG and any other background gives JPG, at the original size.
tr: El format del fitxer es tria per tu. Amb un marketplace, les fotos segueixen la seva mida i el seu format. Sense marketplace, un fons transparent dona PNG i qualsevol altre fons dona JPG, a la mida original.
back: The file format is chosen by you. With a marketplace, the photos follow their size and format. Without a marketplace, a transparent background gives PNG and any other background gives JPG, to the original size.

en: Choosing Amazon switches the background to White; if you then choose another background, Amazon is switched off. eBay, Etsy and Shopify keep your background, but a JPG cannot be transparent, so it gets a white background.
tr: Triar Amazon canvia el fons a Blanc; si després tries un altre fons, Amazon es desmarca. eBay, Etsy i Shopify conserven el teu fons, però un JPG no pot ser transparent i per això rep un fons blanc.
back: Choosing Amazon changes the fund to White; if you then choose another fund, Amazon is de-listed. eBay, Etsy and Shopify keep your fund, but a JPG cannot be transparent and therefore receives a white fund.

en: If the HD model is installed, every photo in the batch is cut out with it. The Get HD cut-out button next to Templates downloads it.
tr: Si el model HD està instal·lat, totes les fotos del lot es retallen amb aquest model. El botó Obtén el retall HD, al costat de Plantilles, el baixa.
back: If the HD model is installed, all photos of the lot are cut with this model.

en: Each photo is saved to your gallery and to Recent Exports as soon as it finishes. Stop ends the batch after the current photo, and photos already finished stay saved. If a photo fails, the batch carries on and tells you how many could not be processed. Done takes you back to the home screen; it does not save anything.
tr: Cada foto es desa a la galeria i a Exportacions recents tan bon punt s’acaba. Atura finalitza el lot després de la foto en curs, i les fotos ja acabades continuen desades. Si una foto falla, el lot continua i t’indica quantes no s’han pogut processar. Fet et porta de nou a la pantalla d’inici; no desa res.
back: Each photo is sent to the gallery and to Recent Exports so good point ends. Atura finishes the batch after the current photo, and the already finished photos continue to be taken. If a photo fails, the batch continues and tells you how many have not been processed.

en: Recent Exports on the home screen shows your latest exports. Tap See all for every export, grouped as Today, Yesterday, This week and Earlier.
tr: Exportacions recents, a la pantalla d’inici, mostra les últimes exportacions. Toca Mostra-ho tot per veure-les totes, agrupades en Avui, Ahir, Aquesta setmana i Anteriors.
back: Recent exports, on the home screen, shows the latest exports. Tap Show it all to see them all, grouped into Today, Yesterday, This Week and Past.

en: Tap an export to open it full screen. Swipe to move between exports and pinch to zoom. The bar at the bottom has Share, Save to Gallery, Edit again and Delete.
tr: Toca una exportació per obrir-la a pantalla completa. Llisca per canviar d’una a una altra i pessiga per ampliar. La barra inferior ofereix Comparteix, Desa a la Galeria, Edita de nou i Elimina.
back: Tap an export to open it on full screen. Slide to switch from one to the other and dial to expand. The bottom bar offers Share, Challenge to Gallery, Edit Again and Delete.

en: The three-dot button on a tile opens the same actions. Edit again opens the exported picture as a new photo, so earlier brush strokes are not restored.
tr: El botó de tres punts d’una miniatura obre les mateixes accions. Edita de nou obre la imatge exportada com una foto nova, de manera que els traços de pinzell anteriors no es restauren.
back: The three-point button of a thumbnail opens the same actions. Edit again opens the exported image as a new photo, so that the previous brushstrokes are not restored.

en: Select lets you choose several exports to share together or delete. Delete all exports removes every export from this phone.
tr: Selecciona et permet triar diverses exportacions per compartir-les o eliminar-les juntes. Elimina totes les exportacions treu totes les exportacions d’aquest telèfon.
back: Select allows you to select multiple exports to share or delete together. Deletes all exports minus all exports from that phone.

en: Deleting removes exports from PhotoSur only. Pictures already saved to your gallery are not affected. The bottom of the See all screen shows how much space exports use on this phone.
tr: Eliminar treu les exportacions només de PhotoSur. Les imatges ja desades a la galeria no es toquen. A la part inferior de Mostra-ho tot veus quant d’espai ocupen les exportacions en aquest telèfon.
back: Delete Exports only from PhotoSur. Images already in the gallery are not touched. At the bottom of Show it all you can see how much space the exports occupy on this phone.

en: Your photos are processed on your phone and are not uploaded. There is no account and no watermark.
tr: Les fotos es processen al telèfon i no es pugen enlloc. No hi ha cap compte ni cap marca d’aigua.
back: The photos are processed on the phone, and they don't go anywhere. There's no account or watermark.

en: PhotoSur is free with every feature included, supported by ads. A banner appears at the bottom of some screens, and an ad can appear after an export.
tr: PhotoSur és gratuïta, amb totes les funcions incloses, i es finança amb publicitat. A la part inferior d’algunes pantalles apareix un bàner, i després d’una exportació pot aparèixer un anunci.
back: PhotoSur is free, with all features included, and is funded by advertising. At the bottom of some screens a banner appears, and after an export an ad may appear.

en: Go Ad-Free in Settings is a one-time purchase that removes the ads. It does not unlock anything else, because every feature is already free. Restore Purchases brings it back on a new phone.
tr: Sense anuncis, a Configuració, és una compra única que elimina els anuncis. No desbloqueja res més, perquè totes les funcions ja són gratuïtes. Restaura les compres la recupera en un telèfon nou.
back: No ads, in Configuration, it's a one-time purchase that deletes ads. It doesn't unlock anything else, because all the features are already free. Restores the purchases it recovers on a new phone.

en: Theme can follow your phone, or be Light or Dark. Language changes the language of the app. Both are also in the home screen header.
tr: Tema pot seguir el telèfon o ser Clar o Fosc. Idioma canvia l’idioma de l’aplicació. Tots dos també són a la capçalera de la pantalla d’inici.
back: The theme can follow the phone or be Clear or Fosc. Language changes the language of the application. Both are also in the headset of the start screen.

en: Edit reminders: if you leave the app with an unfinished edit, PhotoSur can remind you three hours later. Switch this off in Settings.
tr: Recordatoris d’edició: si surts de l’aplicació amb una edició sense acabar, PhotoSur t’ho pot recordar al cap de tres hores. Desactiva-ho a Configuració.
back: Edit Reminders: If you leave the app with an unfinished edition, PhotoSur can remember it within three hours.

en: HD cut-out model shows whether it is installed. Remove deletes it from your phone to free space; you can download it again at any time.
tr: Model de retall HD indica si està instal·lat. Elimina el treu del telèfon per alliberar espai; el pots tornar a baixar quan vulguis.
back: HD cut model indicates if it's installed. Remove the tray from the phone to free up space; you can download it again whenever you want.

en: Replay intro shows the welcome screens again. Support opens the support page. Animated home background turns the moving picture at the top of the home screen on or off.
tr: Torna a veure la introducció mostra de nou les pantalles de benvinguda. Assistència obre la pàgina d’assistència. Fons animat de l'inici activa o desactiva la imatge en moviment a la part superior de la pantalla d'inici.
back: Re-view the introduction shows the welcome screens again. Assist opens the assistance page. Start background animated or deactivates the moving image at the top of the start screen.

en: If the automatic cut-out cannot run on a very old or low-memory phone, the brush still works, so you can finish the picture by hand.
tr: Si el retall automàtic no es pot executar en un telèfon molt antic o amb poca memòria, el pinzell continua funcionant, de manera que pots acabar la imatge a mà.
back: If automatic cutting can't be done on a very old or memory-poor phone, the brush continues to work, so you can finish the image by hand.

en: If the HD download stops, check your connection and try again. It continues where it left off.
tr: Si la baixada HD s’atura, comprova la connexió i torna-ho a provar. Continua des d’on s’havia aturat.
back: If the downloaded HD is off, check the connection and try again.

en: For anything else, open Support from Settings.
tr: Per a qualsevol altre problema, obre Assistència des de Configuració.
back: For any other problems, open Assistance from Configuration.
